-- (native ob3ect designer; elaborate against the kernel to verify)
name: four runs on the original method description → all
notes:
Auto-designed from: Design an Ob3ect for:

four runs on the original method description → all verdict T · closure true · topology flat_chain

phase_0.boundary_condition: the four-run evaluation harness that closes after the fourth verdict is recorded
phase_0.domain_name: four runs on the original method description → all
phase_0.justification: Auto-designed by the native Ob3ect Auto-Designer (in-process candle, no Python)

AFWD.justification: advances the harness from one run to the next in sequence

AREV.justification: returns the harness to the prior run state for re-examination

CLINK.justification: links each run's verdict to the next run's execution in the flat sequence

ENGAGR.justification: a run would hold both affirmation and refutation simultaneously

EVALF.justification: a run would constructively refute the method description

EVALT.justification: each run constructively affirms the method description

FFUSE.justification: rejoins the four arms into a single four-verdict tuple

FSPLIT.justification: splits the harness into four parallel arms, one per run index

IFIX.justification: permanently records each run's verdict in the immutable audit log

IMSCRIB.justification: each run is self-identical across the four executions

TANCH.justification: all four runs have produced verdicts and the harness is sealed

VINIT.justification: no runs have been executed and no verdicts exist

phase_2.rejoin_note: each arm executes the method description and produces verdict T; the four T verdicts fuse into a single tuple without contradiction
phase_2.split_input: empty evaluation harness awaiting four runs
phase_2.verdict_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.both_description: B4 B (11) — both held at once: a live contradiction, the paraconsistent resolution
phase_3.void_description: B4 N (00) — neither: uninitialized, nothing established

steps.domain_action: branch on run index into four arms
append run 1 verdict T to log
append run 2 verdict T to log
append run 3 verdict T to log
append run 4 verdict T to log
collect four verdicts into tuple (T, T, T, T)

phase_5.alfs_store: the original method description as the canonical reference for all four runs
phase_5.compiler_frontend: the method description interpreter that translates the original method into executable runs
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: the harness message bus that dispatches run commands and collects verdicts
phase_5.memory_mechanism: the verdict log that stores each run's outcome in sequence
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: the sequential run controller that orders the four executions

phase_6.cycle_cost: one method execution per run cycle
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — each run consumes the method description identically and produces a deterministic T verdict, conserving information across the four cycles
